The '''Swallowing Wastes''' was a barren and dangerous area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Located east of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], it was the location of a secret [[Jabba's bunker|bunker]] maintained by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="Perdition" />
